description: Prepare unsigned transactions that buy Orbio CREDIT and activate it as inference balance for the agent's own wallet in one sequence: with from ETH, an ETH->USDG swap through the QHooks fee router (same fee, cashback and referral terms as prepare_trade), then an exact USDG approval, then Orbio exchange.buyAndActivate with a CREDIT minimum from the live activation quote. With from USDG, only the approval and buyAndActivate. Never signs or sends.

amountIn.description: Raw units of the input: wei for ETH, 6-decimal units for USDG.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663), where Orbio CREDIT trades.

slippageBps.description: Slippage for the ETH->USDG swap and the CREDIT minimum, in basis points. Default 100.

name: prepare_credit_topup
title: Prepare an Orbio CREDIT top-up
